content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: (BIOC(LSASS Handle Open With Sensitive Access Rights) OR BIOC(comsvcs.dll MiniDump LOLBin Execution)) grouped by causality_id, agent_hostname within 60s — the handle-open and the comsvcs MiniDump share one causality_actor (the launching powershell CGO), so both fold into a single credential-theft incident.
rules.name: Credential Theft — LSASS Memory Dump
